insight: Y Combinator W24 startup; runs its own 'Avalon' speech model tuned for prompt-style speech and code vocabulary.
name: Aqua Voice
tagline: Fast, accurate voice typing for any app.
description: A desktop dictation app that turns speech into text across any application, powered by its in-house Avalon model and tuned for low latency. Adds a custom dictionary and formatting so dictated text comes out clean, with a free tier and unlimited paid plans.

modelSupport.notes: Built around Aqua's own Avalon speech model.

edge: Its purpose-built Avalon model targets low latency and handles prompt-style speech and code, where general dictation tools mis-transcribe technical terms.
pros: Types into any app on your desktop
